Session date: 2:03 pm on 11 May, 2023
[D6:1] Andrew: Hi Audrey! I had a great hike last weekend with some friends and my girlfriend at the spot we found recently. Nature was so peaceful – it was so nice to just relax and take it in. How's your week been? Anything exciting going on lately?

I signed up for a workshop about bonding with my pet next month. Can't wait to learn new stuff and strengthen my bond with my pets. What's up with you?
[D6:3] Andrew: That's awesome! Glad have the opportunity to bond with your pets. That workshop sounds cool. Where did you hear about it? And the one in the picture is adorable!

Session date: 11:27 am on 2 June, 2023
[D7:2] Andrew: That sounds amazing! Must have been so happy watching them running around. It's moments like that which show us how amazing animals are. Glad you had a great time. By the way, I think you mentioned before that you've taken them on a hiking trip? 
[D7:3] Audrey: Yeah, I took them for a hike before. We went to a national park last week and made it to this beautiful peak. It was stunning during the sunset, and I'll never forget it. Session date: 7:59 pm on 4 November, 2023
[D27:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, had a great weekend! My girlfriend and I went on a bike ride and stumbled upon a cool park outside of town. It was awesome to get away from the city and be surrounded by nature.
[D27:2] Audrey: That's cool! I love checking out new parks with my four pups. Last weekend was so fun - our dogs were able to run around and get some fresh air. On top of that, I recently joined a dog owners group to learn how to better take care of them.
[D27:3] Andrew: That sounds great! Your four pups must have a lot of fun. How often do you hang out with the dog owners group?
[D27:4] Audrey: Yeah, they're having a lot of fun. I try to meet up with other dog owners once a week for tips from other parents and so they can all play together. How about you? Have you ever thought about joining one?
[D27:5] Andrew: That looks fun! Seeing those adorable pups made me think about getting another dog, but I'm still not sure. Having two dogs is already a lot to take care of. Do you have any tips on being a multi-dog pet owner?
[D27:6] Audrey: Maybe you want to take care of Toby and Buddy first. Having them happy and healthy would be a good first step before going all in for more dogs.

Session date: 9:58 pm on 16 August, 2023
[D15:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, since we last spoke I got another tattoo of my four dogs on my arm! They really mean a lot to me so I thought it'd be nice to have them with me wherever I go. What've you been up to?
[D15:2] Andrew: Wow that's so cool! I recently went to a farm with my girlfriend to get some fresh veggies for dinner, and it was really nice. Have you been thinking about getting more fur babies or is four enough?
[D15:3] Audrey: Sounds great! I'd love to have more, but four is enough for now. They keep me busy and I want to make sure I give each of them the attention they deserve - four dogs is already a lot! I took them all to the vet and got them checked up, it was such a havoc that next time I'll bring them one by one.
[...]
[D15:19] Audrey: Thanks! I'll always cherish those moments. They really make life so much brighter.
Session date: 9:19 pm on 19 August, 2023
[D16:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, hope you're doing good! So I've decided to take a break from work yesterday and check out a new cafe. It was a nice change and reminded me of how the great outdoors is always there to offer you peace. Here's a photo from my last hike - so serene! How's your month been so far?

[...]

[D16:18] Audrey: No wonder. Now I can't wait for the pics. Take care and have fun! My dogs will be waiting too!
[D16:19] Andrew: Thanks! Can't wait to show you them when I'm back. See ya!

Session date: 7:09 pm on 1 October, 2023
[D20:1] Andrew: Hey wassup? Got some great news - the gf and I are hitting the beach next month with Toby!
[D20:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Great to hear from you. Have fun at the beach trip! Bet you can't wait to get out to the nature. Can't wait for our hike with the dogs next month. They always put a smile on my face - life's just not the same without them!
[D20:3] Andrew: Thanks, I will! Yea I can't wait for the hike. It's been a long time since we all be in nature together.

[...]
[D20:7] Andrew: Sounds great! Missing that experience. Can't wait for the coming up hike!
[D20:8] Audrey: Yeah, Andrew! The pups and I are loving it. Being out in nature and checking out new trails with the dogs is so different from being in the city.
[D20:9] Andrew: I think everyone's gotta ditch the hustle and bustle every now and then. It's so refreshing to be in nature.
[...]
[D20:15] Andrew: Yeah do that! It's really peaceful and calming. It's nice to get away from the city and enjoy nature. Let me know if you need any birdwatching advice, I think I know a thing or two about bird watching. Or perhaps we can all go birdwatching soometimes.
[D20:16] Audrey: Thanks! That's so helpful, I'd love to take you up on your offer. Right now I'm going with this book that writes about bird watching guides.
